title: Booking
description: A reservation for one apartment. Captured via CDC (Debezium → Kafka) whenever a row is inserted or updated in the bookings table (Phase 18, ADR-0011 backlog #13 prerequisite).

booking_id.description: Idempotency key. Used by Flink sinks to deduplicate on replay — the same role payment_line.v1's event_id plays.

apartment_id.description: Surrogate key from the PMS database (UUID or integer as string). Matches payment_line.v1's apartment_id.

check_out.description: Departure date. The night of check_out itself is not occupied — nights occupied are [check_in, check_out).

channel.description: Sales channel this booking came through. Includes 'direct', unlike price_decision.v1's ChannelPriceCandidate.platform — this is an independent entity.

guests.description: Number of guests on this booking.

revenue_eur.description: Total revenue for this booking, gross, in EUR.

status.description: A cancelled booking is excluded from occupied-night calculations from the moment this status is observed — it is not retroactively removed from any decision already made using the earlier occupancy figure.
